# Kernels chosen per Apple GPU family

Gemma 4 E4B (`e4b-ours`, 8K window, MTP on) on this Mac (Apple M6). The simulated rows set `AGELLO_SIMULATE_APPLE_GPU`, so ML Drift picks the kernels it would pick on that GPU; the hardware, and its arithmetic, stay the M6's. A kernel name is the first operation of a fused node (`fc1x1_int8_weights -> cast -> ...` counts as `fc1x1_int8_weights`).
